svg.title: Project 02 — Structural Beam Layout Plan (3rd Floor Roof)
svg.desc: Authoritative architectural and structural engineering beam layout plan of the 7-storied residential apartment building at Basundhara, Dhaka (Sheet A-02). Showing true stepped building perimeter, 12 RC columns, shear wall lift core, primary beams FB1 to FB13, cantilever beam CB, slab zones TH=5" and TH=6", stair void, and light court.

g.text: SHEET NO: A-02 • SCALE: 1:100 • RESIDENTIAL BUILDING
